integrity: Exact-rational finite checks corroborate, but do not substitute for, the analytical all-parameter proof. No independent mathematical audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns integer-slope expanding interval maps, Lebesgue initial states and coordinate-Euclidean non-geodesic one-step lengths. The exact Gaussian limit is distributional; zero covariance is not independence. Prior-art verification is best-knowledge and subject to independent review.
title: Exact step-length memory reversal in integer expanding interval maps
